text:
sophie: Heads-up — prepping the AWS/GCP/Azure listings for next-week cadence. Need final mapping for demo entitlements (trial vs paid), the hero image variants, and legal signoff on the EULA copy by Friday. Anyone blocked?

mike: On SKU mapping — I started a small table. Quick Q: do we expose per-seat pricing or just trial/unlimited trial for the marketplace trial SKU? :thinking_face:

raj: For now let's expose a single trial SKU + paid SKU. Per-seat complicates metering across clouds. We can add metered SKUs in a later iteration.

jess: I'll prepare hero image variants (3:2 for AWS marketplace, 16:9 for GCP/Azure storefront). Uploading to Drive now: https://drive.redwood.example/marketplace-assets/1715 :camera_flash:

nora: Legal needs the final EULA snippet and entitlements table. If you can paste the table here or link a doc I'll do a quick pass. Deadline OK for Fri EOD.

mike: Pasting minimal SKU mapping (will attach spreadsheet to Drive):
```
SKU,cloud,visibility,type
RED-TRIAL,aws,gcp,trial
RED-PRO,aws,gcp,azure,paid
```
Realizing I need to split RED-PRO by cloud-specific offer ids — will add.

sam: Staging creds: I spun up publisher staging accounts for AWS/GCP/Azure. Credentials and role instructions here: `docs/internal/marketplace/staging-creds.md`. Deploy-bot just published the staging bundle build-278 to those accounts.

deploy-bot: build-278 uploaded to publisher-staging (aws:gcp:azure) — manifest v2 attached. Use `manifest-v2.json` for offer metadata.

jess: @mike @sam — can you confirm the hero images are allowed in AWS hero size? AWS has a 1MB limit — I can compress, but need final images by tomorrow.

mike: Confirmed — I'll prune metadata and optimize images after you upload. Also: please add alt text for accessibility.

nora: Uploaded a first-pass EULA snippet with placeholders for trial duration and data retention: https://docs.redwood.example/legal/eulas/marketplace-draft.md — fill placeholders and tag me.

raj: Reminder: product packaging needs a short feature bullets list (max 5) for the listing blurb. I put a draft in the product doc: `product/marketplace-listing-blurb.md`. Feedback welcome.

jess: Drafted three CTAs — "Try free for 14 days", "Request a demo", "Contact sales" — prefer the 14-day trial CTA for the marketplace listing.

mike: One more integration note: for Azure private offers we need the manifest to reference `offerId` and `planId` fields separately. I'll generate the cloud-specific mapping and drop it in Drive by EOD.

nora: Legal OK on trial length 14 days. Two asks: clarify data deletion policy in listing and ensure KMS mention in Private offer docs.

sam: KMS is configured for Private packages; adding how-to in the private deployment doc and linking to the listing copy.

sophie: Great progress — action items recap: 1) Mike to finish cloud-specific offerId mapping + upload spreadsheet (EOD). 2) Jess to upload compressed hero images + alt text (tomorrow). 3) Raj to finalize blurb + feature bullets (tomorrow AM). 4) Nora to finalize EULA after placeholders filled (Fri EOD). 5) Sam to confirm staging creds & KMS notes (tomorrow). We'll do a final pre-submit check Wed 11am PT. Thanks all :thumbsup:

mike: will do.

jess: on it, uploading now.

nora: tagging when updated.

sam: staging creds and KMS notes linked in the Drive folder.

sophie: meeting invite sent for Wed 11am PT — calendar: https://calendar.redwood.example/event/marketplace-preflight-1715

raj: I'll join.

mike: quick FYI — discovered a SKU naming clash with an internal beta SKU (RED-BETA). I'll remap to RED-BETA-LEGACY and exclude from marketplace visibility.

jess: noted. updating asset names.

sophie: Thanks — closing thread for now. Ping me if anything slips. :sparkles:
